Compared Batch 2 rows 2–250, columns A (Products) and B (Suggested New URL Structure), with the export’s Handle. Matched products were cross-checked against Style Code, with an independent style-code search for missing handles.

Normalization covered case, spaces versus hyphens, and pant/pants, short/shorts and kshort/kshorts. All numeric and colour identifiers were preserved. Rows 197 and 198 use kshort in the sheet and KSHORTS in the export; their numeric codes and colours agree.
All 135 matches use the suggested URL handle. None use the original product handle, and no additional products were recovered through style-code matching.

These findings describe the supplied export snapshot, not a fresh storefront crawl. Published=false is separate from draft status. Absence from this active-only export cannot distinguish draft, archived, deleted, omitted, or renamed products. The export’s file hash is identical to the one used for Batch 1.
